Optional Clinical Education
*
6
(1 month)
* Clinical practice at the Åland Health and Care Services
(ÅHS) can be offered mainly within primary care but also in hospital wards. This offers unique opportunities to experience the solutions at hand in rural and archipelago preventive health care, nursing, basic medical treatments, and rehabilitation without limitations as to disorders, age or patient groups.
Primary care is a complement to hospital care and treats illnesses that do not require hospitalisation. The work practice consists mainly of day-time work in the form of home care in private residences or special homes as well as surgery hours.

Language of Instruction
The language of instruction at Åland UAS is Swedish but our degree programmes offer a selection of courses in English for exchange students. Required English level is B2.
For exchange students who whish to study courses instructed in Swedish, these can be added to a student’s application, upon request. Required Swedish level is B1-B2.
